original.statement: The CLI flag `--clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` has been removed in favor of `--clustermesh-sync-timeout`.

decision.reason: [ev-98d8079a3380] says the previously deprecated `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag "has been removed in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`". So the subject is the cli-flag `--clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout`, with no component because the text names none. The change is "removed", with `--clustermesh-sync-timeout` as the replacement. The validators were inconclusive only because the chart failed to render, which neither confirms nor contradicts this.
